articles.title: 25 women making moves in healthcare
articles.summary: Several women have recently stepped into new executive roles at hospitals and health systems — including through promotions, new appointments or planned retirements. While women hold most entry-level positions in healthcare, they made up just 35% of C-suite leaders in 2024, an increase from 29% in 2020.

articles.title: Ascension Illinois launches free drug program
articles.summary: Ascension Illinois has launched a pharmacy assistance program aimed at expanding medication access for low-income, uninsured residents across Chicago and its suburbs. The initiative is part of a national partnership with Dispensary of Hope, a nonprofit organization that distributes free, donated pharmaceuticals through more than 200 partner sites.
